nameOrigin: an alloy of platinum, the game of which it is the mascot

pokedexEntries.dp: A Pokémon that is said to live in a world on the reverse side of ours. It appears in an ancient cemetery.

pokedexEntries.pt: It was banished for its violence. It silently gazed upon the old world from the Distortion World.

pokedexEntries.hgss: This Pokémon is said to live in a world on the reverse side of ours, where common knowledge is distorted and strange.
